market_outlook.short_term: Markets in tug-of-war: Hormuz deal hopes vs. 5% bond yields. Stocks trimming losses but bond pressure caps upside. Oil volatile above $103. Dollar strength continues. Nike downgrade and Oracle debt create idiosyncratic drags. USTR Greer Monday details on China trade are key catalyst. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy, value, and AI infrastructure over premium consumer.
market_outlook.long_term: 5% yield regime structurally pressures equities and housing. AI sovereignty and chip competition create multi-year winners. US-China trade remains cyclical (2-month truces). Grid modernization and energy transition provide 5-10 year investment runway. Consumer bifurcation persists. Post-quantum security and AI safety become institutional allocation themes. Brazil fiscal stimulus and EU-UK tariff alignment reshape global trade flows.
